title: Big Five
source: IPIP-NEO-120 (Johnson, 2014), 120 items / 30 facets / 5 domains. Items transcribed verbatim and cross-checked across two public-domain sources; see content-sources/bigfive.md.
citation: Johnson, J. A. (2014). Measuring thirty facets of the Five Factor Model with a 120-item public domain inventory: Development of the IPIP-NEO-120. Journal of Research in Personality, 51, 78–89. Items: International Personality Item Pool (public domain), ipip.ori.org.
intro: This is the long one — 120 short statements about how you typically think, feel, and act. It maps five broad domains and thirty finer facets. It is a mirror of your raw material, not a verdict or a grade. Answer for how you generally are, not how you wish to be.

sections.title: Before you start
sections.body: There are no right answers and no good or bad scores — every trait has a light side and a shadow. Bands (low / balanced / high) are shown, not precise points, because the instrument’s real resolution is coarse and its norms are adult and English. Read it as tendencies, in August of DP1, not a fixed identity.

items.text: Believe in the importance of art
Use others for my own ends
Find it difficult to approach others
Believe that I am better than others
Tend to vote for liberal political candidates
Believe that others have good intentions
Talk to a lot of different people at parties
See beauty in things that others might not notice
Often forget to put things back in their proper place
Am afraid to draw attention to myself
Prefer to stick with things that I know
Do more than what's expected of me
Believe that there is no absolute right and wrong
Feel sympathy for those who are worse off than myself
Leave a mess in my room
Am often down in the dumps
Am indifferent to the feelings of others
Do a lot in my spare time
Do just enough work to get by
Have a high opinion of myself
Feel that I'm unable to deal with things
Tend to vote for conservative political candidates
Am not interested in other people's problems
Like to get lost in thought
Know how to get things done
Do not enjoy going to art museums
Wait for others to lead the way
Don't understand people who get emotional
Am not bothered by difficult social situations
Put little time and effort into my work
Am able to control my cravings
Am not interested in theoretical discussions
Look at the bright side of life
Believe that we should be tough on crime
Try not to think about the needy

scales.name: Neuroticism
scales.construct_explainer: Neuroticism reflects a tendency toward negative emotions like worry, irritation, and low mood, and how strongly stress is felt. It is not weakness — it tracks how sensitively a person registers threat and setback.

low.light: Answers leaning lower often go with staying steady and unbothered under stress.
low.shadow: A very low lean can miss real warning signals that discomfort usually flags.
low.one_thing_to_try: Notice one situation where a little unease would actually be useful.

balanced.light: A middle lean tends to feel stress without being ruled by it.
balanced.shadow: It can swing toward the rough end on a hard week.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Spot the earliest sign that stress is building, and name it.

high.light: Answers leaning higher often go with feeling things deeply and noticing problems early.
high.shadow: Strong negative emotion can outrun the facts and wear a person down.
high.one_thing_to_try: When upset, check whether the feeling matches the size of the trigger.

scales.name: Extraversion
scales.construct_explainer: Extraversion reflects how much someone is energised by people, activity, and stimulation, and how outwardly warm and assertive they tend to be.

low.light: A lower lean often goes with comfort in solitude and depth in one-to-one settings.
low.shadow: It can be read as distance, and big rooms can drain energy fast.
low.one_thing_to_try: Pick one social setting that is genuinely worth the energy this week.

balanced.light: A middle lean moves between company and quiet fairly easily.
balanced.shadow: It can default to whichever the people around set.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Choose, on purpose, when to lead the room and when to step back.

high.light: A higher lean often goes with warmth, energy, and ease in groups.
high.shadow: It can crowd out reflection and quieter voices.
high.one_thing_to_try: Leave deliberate space for one quieter person to speak.

scales.name: Openness to Experience
scales.construct_explainer: Openness reflects appetite for ideas, art, novelty, and inner experience — curiosity and imagination versus a preference for the familiar and concrete.

low.light: A lower lean often goes with practicality and a steady preference for what works.
low.shadow: It can wave away new ideas before really testing them.
low.one_thing_to_try: Try one unfamiliar idea or method long enough to judge it fairly.

balanced.light: A middle lean mixes curiosity with a liking for the proven.
balanced.shadow: It can stall between the new and the familiar.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Pick one area to explore and one to keep simple.

high.light: A higher lean often goes with imagination, curiosity, and love of the new.
high.shadow: It can chase novelty and lose the thread of the practical.
high.one_thing_to_try: Carry one new idea all the way to something finished.

scales.name: Agreeableness
scales.construct_explainer: Agreeableness reflects how much someone prioritises getting along — trust, kindness, cooperation, and humility — versus competing and putting their own case first.

low.light: A lower lean often goes with directness and a willingness to challenge and compete.
low.shadow: It can read as harsh and miss others’ needs.
low.one_thing_to_try: In one disagreement, name the other side’s point before your own.

balanced.light: A middle lean balances cooperation with standing its ground.
balanced.shadow: It can give way too far, or dig in, depending on the day.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Decide in advance one thing worth holding firm on.

high.light: A higher lean often goes with warmth, trust, and easy cooperation.
high.shadow: It can avoid needed conflict and get taken advantage of.
high.one_thing_to_try: Say no, kindly, to one thing that does not serve you.

scales.name: Conscientiousness
scales.construct_explainer: Conscientiousness reflects how organised, dependable, and goal-directed a person tends to be — planning, persistence, and self-control versus flexibility and spontaneity.

low.light: A lower lean often goes with flexibility and ease with the unplanned.
low.shadow: It can show as missed deadlines and half-finished plans.
low.one_thing_to_try: Pick one task and finish it before starting another.

balanced.light: A middle lean gets things done without rigid control.
balanced.shadow: It can drift when no deadline pushes.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Set one small deadline for something with none.

high.light: A higher lean often goes with discipline, order, and follow-through.
high.shadow: It can tip into rigidity, overwork, or trouble resting.
high.one_thing_to_try: Let one low-stakes thing be merely good enough.

scales.name: Anxiety
scales.construct_explainer: Anxiety reflects a tendency to feel worried, tense, or on edge about what might go wrong.

low.light: Tends to stay calm and unworried in uncertainty.
low.shadow: May underestimate real risks worth preparing for.
low.one_thing_to_try: Name one risk that deserves a second look.

balanced.light: Reads threat about right most of the time.
balanced.shadow: Can tip into worry on a heavy day.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Notice which situations spin up the most worry.

high.light: Alert early to what could go wrong.
high.shadow: Worry can outrun the facts and tire the mind.
high.one_thing_to_try: Ask whether the worry matches the actual odds.

scales.name: Anger
scales.construct_explainer: Anger reflects how readily someone feels frustration or irritation when things go against them.

low.light: Slow to irritate; hard to provoke.
low.shadow: May swallow frustration that should be voiced.
low.one_thing_to_try: Name one annoyance instead of letting it pass.

balanced.light: Feels irritation but usually keeps it in proportion.
balanced.shadow: Can flare under pressure.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Catch the early heat before it speaks for you.

high.light: Quick to register when something is unfair.
high.shadow: Irritation can flare faster than it fades.
high.one_thing_to_try: Put one beat between the spark and the reply.

scales.name: Depression
scales.construct_explainer: Depression (as a facet) reflects a tendency toward low mood, discouragement, and feeling down.

low.light: Mood tends to stay buoyant and steady.
low.shadow: May overlook when something genuinely needs grieving.
low.one_thing_to_try: Let one disappointment be felt rather than skipped.

balanced.light: Has low patches but generally recovers.
balanced.shadow: Can dip further under a run of setbacks.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Notice the first sign mood is sliding.

high.light: Feels setbacks and loss deeply and honestly.
high.shadow: Low mood can settle in and dim motivation.
high.one_thing_to_try: Pair one hard feeling with one small action.

scales.name: Self-Consciousness
scales.construct_explainer: Self-Consciousness reflects sensitivity to others’ judgement and discomfort in social or evaluative situations.

low.shadow: May miss how actions land on others.
low.one_thing_to_try: Ask once how something came across.

balanced.light: Feels some social nerves but functions through them.
balanced.shadow: Can shrink in high-stakes attention.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Do one slightly exposing thing on purpose.

high.light: Tuned in to how things look to others.
high.shadow: Fear of judgement can hold back action.
high.one_thing_to_try: Act on one thing despite the worry about looking foolish.

scales.name: Immoderation
scales.construct_explainer: Immoderation reflects difficulty resisting urges and cravings — acting on impulse rather than restraint.

low.light: Strong restraint with urges and temptations.
low.shadow: Restraint can tip into denying real wants.
low.one_thing_to_try: Allow one small pleasure on purpose.

balanced.light: Usually resists, sometimes gives in.
balanced.shadow: Can slip when tired or stressed.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Spot the cue that usually precedes a slip.

high.light: Comfortable following an impulse and enjoying the moment.
high.shadow: Hard-to-resist urges can crowd out longer goals.
high.one_thing_to_try: Put one small barrier between urge and action.

scales.name: Vulnerability
scales.construct_explainer: Vulnerability reflects how easily someone feels overwhelmed or panicked under pressure.

low.light: Stays composed when the pressure spikes.
low.shadow: May press on past a point where help is wiser.
low.one_thing_to_try: Ask for input on one thing before it gets heavy.

balanced.light: Handles most pressure, wobbles under a lot.
balanced.shadow: Can freeze when several things hit at once.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Pre-plan the first step for a high-pressure moment.

high.light: Feels the weight of pressure honestly and early.
high.shadow: Stress can tip into feeling swamped.
high.one_thing_to_try: Break one looming task into its smallest first move.

scales.name: Friendliness
scales.construct_explainer: Friendliness reflects how warmly and easily a person connects with others.

low.light: Reserved; warms up once trust is earned.
low.shadow: Can read as cold before people know you.
low.one_thing_to_try: Offer one small warm signal to someone new.

balanced.light: Warm enough, selective about closeness.
balanced.shadow: Can hang back in fresh groups.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Start one conversation you would normally wait on.

high.light: Quick to make others feel liked and welcome.
high.shadow: Warmth can be spread thin or assumed mutual.
high.one_thing_to_try: Invest in one bond more deeply than usual.

scales.name: Gregariousness
scales.construct_explainer: Gregariousness reflects how much someone seeks out company and the buzz of crowds.

low.light: Content with solitude and small groups.
low.shadow: May skip gatherings that would actually help.
low.one_thing_to_try: Say yes to one larger gathering this week.

balanced.light: Enjoys company in measured doses.
balanced.shadow: Energy for crowds varies by mood.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Match the setting to your energy on purpose.

high.light: Energised by people and busy rooms.
high.shadow: Quiet and alone-time can get crowded out.
high.one_thing_to_try: Protect one block of deliberate solitude.

scales.name: Assertiveness
scales.construct_explainer: Assertiveness reflects how readily someone takes charge, speaks up, and leads.

low.shadow: Own views can go unheard.
low.one_thing_to_try: State one opinion first, before agreeing.

balanced.light: Leads or follows as the situation needs.
balanced.shadow: Can hesitate at the moment to step up.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Take the lead on one small thing.

high.light: Steps up and steers naturally.
high.shadow: Can override quieter people.
high.one_thing_to_try: Ask one question before giving your answer.

scales.name: Activity Level
scales.construct_explainer: Activity Level reflects pace and busyness — how much someone keeps moving and packs in.

low.light: Unhurried; comfortable with a slower pace.
low.shadow: May let momentum stall.
low.one_thing_to_try: Add one active task to a slow day.

balanced.light: Busy when it matters, restful otherwise.
balanced.shadow: Pace can drift with no plan.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Pick the one thing worth real pace today.

high.light: Keeps a fast, full pace.
high.shadow: Constant motion can crowd out rest and thought.
high.one_thing_to_try: Schedule one genuinely empty hour.

scales.name: Excitement-Seeking
scales.construct_explainer: Excitement-Seeking reflects appetite for thrill, stimulation, and novelty.

low.shadow: May avoid worthwhile bold moves.
low.one_thing_to_try: Try one thing slightly outside the comfort zone.

balanced.light: Likes some stimulation, not too much.
balanced.shadow: Boredom or overload can both creep in.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Tune the dial up or down on purpose once.

high.light: Drawn to thrills and high stimulation.
high.shadow: Risk-seeking can outrun good sense.
high.one_thing_to_try: Run one quick risk-check before the leap.

scales.name: Cheerfulness
scales.construct_explainer: Cheerfulness reflects how much someone experiences and shows joy, enthusiasm, and high spirits.

low.light: Even-keeled; not given to high spirits.
low.shadow: Joy can be under-expressed.
low.one_thing_to_try: Mark one good moment out loud.

balanced.light: Has plenty of good moods, not constant.
balanced.shadow: Spark can dip without notice.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name one thing that lifted today.

high.light: Often upbeat and visibly enthusiastic.
high.shadow: Relentless positivity can skip real problems.
high.one_thing_to_try: Let one hard thing be hard before reframing it.

scales.name: Imagination
scales.construct_explainer: Imagination reflects how vivid and active someone’s inner world and fantasy life are.

low.shadow: May leave creative options unexplored.
low.one_thing_to_try: Spend ten minutes imagining a what-if.

balanced.light: Imaginative when it helps, practical otherwise.
balanced.shadow: Daydreaming can come and go.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Aim one daydream at a real problem.

high.light: Rich, active inner world.
high.shadow: Fantasy can pull away from the task at hand.
high.one_thing_to_try: Turn one vivid idea into a concrete sketch.

scales.name: Artistic Interests
scales.construct_explainer: Artistic Interests reflect how much someone is drawn to art, beauty, and aesthetic experience.

low.light: Unmoved by needing art or beauty around.
low.shadow: May miss what aesthetics add.
low.one_thing_to_try: Give one artwork or piece of music real attention.

balanced.light: Appreciates art without seeking it out.
balanced.shadow: Engagement is occasional.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Seek out one aesthetic experience on purpose.

high.light: Moved deeply by art and beauty.
high.shadow: Can prize form over function.
high.one_thing_to_try: Notice one place where plain and useful is enough.

scales.name: Emotionality
scales.construct_explainer: Emotionality (Openness facet) reflects awareness of and access to one’s own feelings.

low.shadow: May lose useful signals feelings carry.
low.one_thing_to_try: Name what one feeling is telling you.

balanced.light: In touch with feelings most of the time.
balanced.shadow: Can tune them out when busy.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Check in on one feeling mid-day.

high.light: Feels emotions richly and notices them.
high.shadow: Strong feeling can flood judgement.
high.one_thing_to_try: Sit with one feeling before acting on it.

scales.name: Adventurousness
scales.construct_explainer: Adventurousness reflects openness to new experiences, variety, and change over routine.

low.shadow: May refuse changes that would help.
low.one_thing_to_try: Change one small routine on purpose.

balanced.light: Open to change in measured amounts.
balanced.shadow: Can default to the usual.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Pick one new option over the default.

high.light: Seeks variety and new experiences.
high.shadow: Restlessness can undervalue what works.
high.one_thing_to_try: Keep one routine that is worth keeping.

scales.name: Intellect
scales.construct_explainer: Intellect reflects appetite for abstract ideas, debate, and intellectual challenge.

low.shadow: May dodge useful complexity.
low.one_thing_to_try: Sit with one hard idea a bit longer.

balanced.light: Enjoys ideas without living in them.
balanced.shadow: Depth varies with interest.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Follow one idea past the first answer.

high.light: Loves abstract, challenging ideas.
high.shadow: Can over-think the simple.
high.one_thing_to_try: Pick the plain explanation once.

scales.name: Liberalism
scales.construct_explainer: Liberalism (as a facet) reflects readiness to question tradition, authority, and the status quo.

low.shadow: May accept rules that deserve questioning.
low.one_thing_to_try: Question one assumption you usually take as given.

balanced.light: Weighs tradition against change.
balanced.shadow: Can sit on the fence.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Take a clear view on one contested question.

high.light: Readily challenges convention and authority.
high.shadow: Can reject the old simply for being old.
high.one_thing_to_try: Find one tradition worth defending.

scales.name: Trust
scales.construct_explainer: Trust reflects how readily someone assumes others are honest and well-intentioned.

low.shadow: Suspicion can block good relationships.
low.one_thing_to_try: Extend one small benefit of the doubt.

balanced.light: Trusts, but verifies.
balanced.shadow: Can misjudge either way.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Notice when caution is data and when it is habit.

high.light: Assumes the best in people.
high.shadow: Can be slow to see real bad faith.
high.one_thing_to_try: Check one claim before acting on it.

scales.name: Morality
scales.construct_explainer: Morality (as a facet) reflects straightforwardness and reluctance to manipulate or use others.

low.shadow: Strategy can slide into using people.
low.one_thing_to_try: Be plain in one exchange where you would usually angle.

balanced.light: Mostly candid, strategic when needed.
balanced.shadow: Can rationalise a shortcut.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name the honest version of one ask.

high.light: Direct, candid, and reluctant to manipulate.
high.shadow: Bluntness can cost needed tact.
high.one_thing_to_try: Soften one true thing without bending it.

scales.name: Altruism
scales.construct_explainer: Altruism reflects willingness to help others and find reward in being useful.

low.shadow: Can miss easy chances to help.
low.one_thing_to_try: Do one small unasked favour.

balanced.light: Helps when it counts.
balanced.shadow: Generosity varies with load.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Offer help once before being asked.

high.light: Generous and quick to help.
high.shadow: Giving can run past your own limits.
high.one_thing_to_try: Decline one ask to protect your own work.

scales.name: Cooperation
scales.construct_explainer: Cooperation reflects how much someone avoids conflict and yields to keep the peace.

low.shadow: Can pick fights that cost more than they win.
low.one_thing_to_try: Let one small disagreement go.

balanced.light: Cooperates but will push back.
balanced.shadow: Can over- or under-yield by mood.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Decide if one issue is worth the friction.

high.light: Smooths conflict and meets others halfway.
high.shadow: Peace-keeping can bury real disputes.
high.one_thing_to_try: Name one disagreement instead of smoothing it.

scales.name: Modesty
scales.construct_explainer: Modesty reflects reluctance to claim superiority or push oneself forward.

low.light: Comfortable owning strengths and standing out.
low.shadow: Confidence can read as arrogance.
low.one_thing_to_try: Credit one other person’s part out loud.

balanced.light: Confident without grandstanding.
balanced.shadow: Can under- or over-claim by context.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: State one real strength plainly, once.

high.light: Humble and slow to claim credit.
high.shadow: Modesty can hide real ability.
high.one_thing_to_try: Take credit for one thing you actually did.

scales.name: Sympathy
scales.construct_explainer: Sympathy reflects how much someone is moved by others’ needs and tender-hearted toward them.

low.shadow: Can miss when compassion is the right call.
low.one_thing_to_try: Sit with one person’s difficulty without fixing it.

balanced.light: Compassionate with a level head.
balanced.shadow: Can swing between soft and detached.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Notice when feeling, not solving, is needed.

high.light: Tender-hearted and easily moved to care.
high.shadow: Soft-heartedness can cloud fair judgement.
high.one_thing_to_try: Weigh one decision on facts as well as feeling.

scales.name: Self-Efficacy
scales.construct_explainer: Self-Efficacy (Conscientiousness facet) reflects confidence in one’s ability to get things done.

low.shadow: Doubt can hold back capable action.
low.one_thing_to_try: Take on one task just past the comfort line.

balanced.light: Fairly confident in getting things done.
balanced.shadow: Confidence dips in new territory.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Recall one past task you pulled off.

high.light: Sure of being able to handle tasks.
high.shadow: Confidence can skip needed preparation.
high.one_thing_to_try: Name one risk before the next big task.

scales.name: Orderliness
scales.construct_explainer: Orderliness reflects how much someone keeps things tidy, planned, and organised.

low.shadow: Disorder can cost time and things.
low.one_thing_to_try: Put one recurring item in a fixed place.

balanced.light: Organised enough to function.
balanced.shadow: Order slips under load.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Tidy the one spot that causes most friction.

high.light: Keeps things neat and well-ordered.
high.shadow: Order can tip into rigidity or fuss.
high.one_thing_to_try: Leave one thing deliberately untidy.

scales.name: Dutifulness
scales.construct_explainer: Dutifulness reflects how strongly someone feels bound by obligations and rules.

low.shadow: Can let real commitments slide.
low.one_thing_to_try: Keep one small promise exactly.

balanced.light: Reliable, with some give.
balanced.shadow: Follow-through varies with interest.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Write down one commitment to make it stick.

high.light: Takes duties and promises seriously.
high.shadow: Rule-following can override good judgement.
high.one_thing_to_try: Question one rule that no longer fits.

scales.name: Achievement-Striving
scales.construct_explainer: Achievement-Striving reflects drive to work hard toward goals and high standards.

low.shadow: Drive can be lower than ability allows.
low.one_thing_to_try: Set one slightly stretching goal.

balanced.light: Works hard for goals that matter.
balanced.shadow: Drive comes and goes.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name the one goal worth real effort now.

high.light: Ambitious and hard-driving.
high.shadow: Striving can crowd out rest and relationships.
high.one_thing_to_try: Call one goal good enough on purpose.

scales.name: Self-Discipline
scales.construct_explainer: Self-Discipline reflects ability to start tasks and push through to finish despite distraction.

low.shadow: Tasks can stall without a push.
low.one_thing_to_try: Use one timer to start a dreaded task.

balanced.light: Finishes most things, with some drift.
balanced.shadow: Distraction wins on low days.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Remove one distraction before starting.

high.light: Starts and finishes reliably.
high.shadow: Pushing through can ignore real limits.
high.one_thing_to_try: Let one task wait when rest matters more.

scales.name: Cautiousness
scales.construct_explainer: Cautiousness reflects how much someone thinks before acting rather than going on impulse.

low.shadow: Speed can skip needed thought.
low.one_thing_to_try: Sleep on one bigger decision.

balanced.light: Balances thinking and acting.
balanced.shadow: Can over- or under-think by mood.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Match the care to the size of the choice.

high.light: Deliberate and careful before acting.
high.shadow: Caution can stall into delay.
high.one_thing_to_try: Make one low-stakes decision quickly.

sections.title: Your turn
sections.prompt: Looking across the five domains and the facets within them: which parts fit, which surprise you, and which do not feel like you at all? Pick one tendency you want to lean into and one you want to push against. Write it in your own words.
